The PNG files are recorded JMA nowcast tiles from the [jma-radar fixtures at 637fd83](https://github.com/ringsaturn/jma-radar/tree/637fd832c4183c34843bc45af577d1d6262e4067/tests/fixtures/hrpns). See [JMA website terms](https://www.jma.go.jp/jma/kishou/info/coment.html).
